POWER SKILL #8

WHY TASK INITIATION IS HARD

You know what to do, you want to do it, and you still can't start. Starting a task runs on a different mental gear than doing it, and for a lot of neurodivergent brains that gear is the one that sticks. So you can fully intend to begin and still sit there at the starting line.

You know what to do, you want to do it, and you still can't start. Starting a task runs on a different mental gear than doing it, and for a lot of neurodivergent brains that gear is the one that sticks. So you can fully intend to begin and still sit there at the starting line.

That gap has a name, task initiation, and it isn't laziness or weak willpower. It's a skill you can build. This workbook shrinks the first step down to something small enough to take, then the next one.

Is this just about motivation?

No. Task initiation is the gap between wanting to start and starting, and it’s common with ADHD and other kinds of neurodivergence. This workbook works on the start itself with small, repeatable steps, not willpower or pep talks.

What format is the workbook?

A printable PDF you can fill in on screen or print at home. It opens on a computer, tablet, or phone.

Can I just buy this one?

Yes. Every Power Skill workbook is $15 on its own. The $79 bundle is the lower-cost way to get all nine.

Is this the same as the free workbook?

No. The free Adulting Like A Champ workbook is the front door. This goes deeper on one Power Skill.

Can I get a refund?

You are fully protected by our 100% Satisfaction Guarantee. If you and your learner aren’t satisfied within 30 days of purchase, just let us know and we’ll send a prompt refund. No refunds are issued beyond this 30-day period.

What if I need it on a different device?

It works on a computer, tablet, or phone. Download it once and use it wherever you like.
